source.branch: mcastu.c:mcast_stun_you tests Antimagic or Free_action. The admitted C line “You feel momentarily disoriented.” proves its resistant branch: when not already Stunned, C calls shieldeff, records M_SEEN_MAGR, prints the feeling, then make_stunned(1,FALSE).
